Step 1. Analyze the question and identify the relevant metrics:
The relevant metrics for calculating the packet loss ratio for received packets for all pods of the ts-order-service are:
- The metric "container_network_receive_packets_total" indicates the cumulative count of packets received by the container. This will be used to calculate the total packets received.
- The metric "container_network_receive_packets_dropped_total" denotes the cumulative count of packets dropped while receiving by the container. This will be used to calculate the total packets dropped.

Step 2. Relevant Metrics List:
```
- {"name": "container_network_receive_packets_total", "type": "counter", "description": "Cumulative count of packets received"}
- {"name": "container_network_receive_packets_dropped_total", "type": "counter", "description": "Cumulative count of packets dropped while receiving"}
```
